en: A black-and-white photograph of a historic European town square, featuring cobblestone streets, 19th-century or early 20th-century buildings with prominent signage in German. The square has a horse-drawn cart, street lamps, and a small number of people scattered around. There are businesses visible on the square, with signs for goods such as wine, wool, cigars, and wallpaper.
